answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the ledge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. The juniper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work.
